answer: CD14 Mono (CD14+ monocytes) has the highest number of significantly differentially expressed genes after AAV9 mini-dystrophin treatment — 315 genes with p_val_adj < 0.05 (no |avg_log2FC| cutoff), counted from the per-cell-type PostvsPre DEG tables. Caveat: with an |avg_log2FC| > 0.5 cutoff the winner flips to CD16 Mono (152 vs 54).
